name: @pipeworx/mcp-google-trends

tools.name: google_trending_searches
tools.description: What is trending on Google today/right now? Returns the current daily trending Google search terms for a country, each with Google's approximate traffic floor (for example "1000+") and related news articles. Keyless. This is the live trending-search snapshot, not historical interest-over-time data.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 two-letter country code (default US), e.g. US, GB, CA, IN, AU.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-google-trends forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the google-trends pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
